methods.summary: Get the instance's public status report.
methods.description:
Get the instance's public status report.

Reads `GET /public/status`: the overall status, chain tip, chain integrity, and the state of each service and decoder.

methods.summary: Turn the status report into a verdict with next steps.
methods.description:
Turn the status report into a verdict with next steps.

Resolves to a `state` (`healthy`, `empty-index`, or `degraded`), the API's own `overall` status, and a list of issues, each with the commands that resolve it. A fresh instance with no blocks indexed reads as `empty-index`, not broken.

types.name: InstanceDiagnosis
types.summary: An instance's state, the API verdict, and the issues found.

fields.name: overall
fields.description: The API's own top-level verdict, passed through unmodified.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What is wrong, in one line.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Why — assembled only from what the payload actually reports.

fields.name: nextSteps
fields.description: What to run next, most useful first.

types.summary: The subset of `/status` a diagnosis reads.

fields.type: { ok?: boolean; maxHeight?: number; reason?: string | null }
